[IDSP.6.7] **No correlation table.** The correlation
string ([IDSP.6.1]) flows through to the
response fact's `corr` slot per LCRS.3 and is
matched by sibling rules via standard rule
patterns. The engine does not maintain an in-
flight-calls table. Supersede-on-correlation
([LCRS.6.2.1]) needs none: it is a sweep of
working memory by `corr` that the engine runs
while evaluating the call, before the dispatcher
is entered ([RLOW.7.3.8]).
